As digital banking continues to redefine the financial services landscape, banks and financial institutions are accelerating investments in customer experience, digital-first propositions, intelligent platforms and scalable innovation models. Against this backdrop, IBS Intelligence is proud to host the sixth edition of the IBSi Digital Banking Awards 2026. 

The IBSi Digital Banking Awards 2026 recognise banks, financial institutions, FinTechs and technology providers that are driving measurable impact through digital banking transformation. The awards celebrate excellence across digital customer engagement, product innovation, implementation quality, programme impact and technology-led banking modernisation. 

The sixth edition of DBA 2026 will spotlight outstanding digital banking initiatives across four broad award categories: Impact Achieved, Customer Focus, Regions and Functional Areas. These categories capture the full spectrum of digital banking excellence, from customer experience, innovation and implementation excellence to consumer banking, SME banking, corporate banking, Islamic banking, private banking and wealth management. 

The awards also recognise digital banking achievements across key global regions, including the Americas, Asia, Australia, Europe and the Middle East & Africa. In addition, DBA 2026 highlights specialised functional areas such as digital onboarding, compliance and RegTech, hyper-personalisation, digital lending, cross-border payments, remittances and digital wallets. 

The sixth edition of DBA reflects the continued evolution of digital banking from channel-led transformation to business-wide impact. It recognises the institutions, teams and technology partners building more seamless, inclusive, personalised and future-ready banking experiences. 

Scheduled for 25 June 2026, the IBSi Digital Banking Awards will bring together global banking and technology leaders to celebrate excellence in digital banking innovation, execution and customer impact. 

For further details, please reach out to nikhilg@ibsintelligence.net.
